events.name: Noche Latina
events.description:
Cynthia Marche is back, and she's bringing the heat. This queen has been keeping Latinx nightlife alive for years, and her show is the kind of spectacle that leaves you breathless—equal parts glamour, humor, and unabashed sensuality. She'll warm you up with a performance that'll make your abuela clutch her pearls (in the best way), then our DJ takes over and keeps the energy climbing all night.

Noche Latina is our monthly love letter to Latinx culture, and it lives in the Ranchero Room—packed, pulsing, unapologetic. The music is pure Latino heat: reggaeton, salsa, bachata, cumbia, whatever makes your hips move. The vibe is provocative without pretense. The crowd is here to feel alive, to laugh, to move, to belong.

Come early, stay late, bring your crew. Cynthia's got jokes and pipes for days. The DJ's got the soundtrack to your night. We've got the drinks and the space where you can be exactly as spicy as you want to be.

events.name: Night of Kings; An all King Drag Show
events.description:
The kings are taking over the Main Floor at Azúcar. Night of Kings is a full-throttle celebration of masculine drag energy—all swagger, all presence, all night. Cherry Pop's hosting the chaos while Dea handles the soundtrack, and the lineup reads like a who's who of regional royalty: Sr Knight Haven Rexia, Jen Durless, Puddlezz, Dick Van Dykeotomy, Edward Demizer, Dominic Trix, Beah Hazard, Phish Takho—each bringing their own flavor of studs and heartthrobs to the stage.

This is the kind of show where the energy hits different. Kings move different. They command the room with a magnetism that pulls you in, and on July 26th, you're witnessing the best of them in one place. The Main Floor is about to feel the full weight of their presence—smooth, sharp, electric.

Come for the performances. Stay for the ritual. Bring your crew.

events.name: Build you own carabiner
events.description:
Clip, clip, hooray. Grab a carabiner, grab some beads, grab your people—you're making your own vibe tonight. Customize a keychain with acrylics and craft your carabiner exactly how you want it. It's tactile, it's playful, it's yours to keep.

Hosted by Jayme in the lounge, with badartclub bringing the creative energy and all the materials you need. No experience required—just show up ready to make something with your hands and maybe find a new crew while you're at it. The bar's open, the space is warm, and you're walking out with proof you were here.

events.description:
Sappholicious Burlesque is coming to shake up Azúcar's main floor with a full female cast that celebrates desire, humor, and community all at once. La Bon is hosting the night—expect high energy, seamless transitions, and a room that feels like it's in on the secret.

events.name: Karaoke
events.description:
The Lounge is yours tonight. Alejandro's spinning the karaoke setup, and the stage is open—no auditions, no judgment, just you and the song that's been living in your head. Sing in Spanish, English, Tagalog, whatever. Belt out a reggaeton anthem, a '90s power ballad, a bolero, a K-pop banger. First-timer or seasoned performer, the mic doesn't discriminate. This is the kind of night where strangers become your hype squad, where three drinks in you find your voice, where the whole room joins the chorus. Come solo or with your crew. Come to shine, come to support, come to witness—Azúcar's Lounge becomes a stage for every body's moment.
